description.from: Requests pricing based on an existing loan file. Loan parameters can be adjusted to allow for scenarios to be built from a loan record.
description.to: Requests pricing based on an existing loan file. Loan parameters can be adjusted to allow for scenarios to be built from a loan record. When credit models are enabled for the organization, the borrower is priced on the loan's credit model and scores unless the scenario customizations override them. Otherwise, and for a loan without a credit model, the borrower is priced as ClassicFICO.

description.from: Response sent when the request is unacceptable
description.to:
Response sent when the request is unacceptable, for example:

- the borrower's creditModel, from the loan or the scenario customizations, is VantageScore4 or FICO10T without a positive score of its own
- credit models are enabled for the organization and a loan created through the loans API is priced on ClassicFICO without a positive fico

description.from: Receive product eligibility and pricing for a product change scenario request, based on the product change policy (current pricing, historical pricing or worst case pricing) for the requested mapped products.
description.to: Receive product eligibility and pricing for a product change scenario request, based on the product change policy (current pricing, historical pricing or worst case pricing) for the requested mapped products. The borrower is priced on the credit model and scores the loan was locked on.

description.from: Gets or sets the FICO score. A three digit score that lenders use to evaluate a borrowers credit worthiness. This credit score ranges from 300-850 with a score above 700 generally being regarded as good credit and anything below 620 generally being regarded as poor credit. The FICO score is the most common type of credit score as it is what the GSE Fannie Mae uses to evaluate the qualification of consumers for Conforming products.
